acceptance: DetectLive gives the incident that the observation touched, and StopBound.record reads the id from it with no index search
A test makes the stop write fail after the incident write, runs the check again, and pins the recurrence count of the incident
Each new test fails before the change and passes after it
fix: Change DetectLive (or add a sibling) to return the touched incident. Use it in StopBound.record in place of next[slices.IndexFunc(...)], which panics on -1. Add the test of a failed stop write after a good incident write.
source: code review g4b6 rounds 2 and 3, MINOR
summary: StopBound.record (ADR-0165 G4b step 6, PR #1395) finds the incident id by an index search with no guard. The search cannot fail today, because DetectLive always yields the incident, but the link is implicit. No test pins the incident recurrence when the stop write fails after the incident write.
title: The stop bound reads the incident that DetectLive touched, and a failed stop write is pinned
